text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 11, 2018) for 204 Montrose Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated December 11, 2018, regarding the property located at 204 Montrose Avenue, Folder No. 18 265993 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to March 21, 2019.
